name: ai.buildersinfintech/fintech-data
title: Builders in Fintech
description: Latest fintech news, rounds, companies, investors, products, Agent-Ready scores. Free and keyless.

tools.name: search_funds
tools.description: Venture funds (fintech, partly fintech or generalist) with their manager, status, stages, latest close and size or target. Amounts are as announced, in their own currency, never converted. size is from the latest first/interim/final close with an amount; a target is never reported as size. Funds focused on other sectors are not included. Arguments: q (or query) matched against fund and manager name; fintech_focus; stage; country (ISO-style country slug, e.g. 'italy'); status; closed_after (YYYY-MM-DD: a close on or after this date); limit. Newest close first. Unknown arguments are rejected.

q.description: Text matched against fund and manager names.

closed_after.description: Only funds with a close on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: list_fund_closes
tools.description: Approved venture-fund closes, newest first: fund, manager, close_type (launch, target, first, interim, final, unspecified), date, amount and currency as announced, source. Amounts are as announced, in their own currency, never converted. size is from the latest first/interim/final close with an amount; a target is never reported as size. Funds focused on other sectors are not included. Arguments: since / until (YYYY-MM-DD), close_type, fintech_focus, limit. Without close_type only first, interim and final closes are listed. Unknown arguments are rejected.

tools.name: list_deploying_funds
tools.description: Funds that raised in the last 24 months and are backing fintech rounds in the last 12: approved funds (not other-sector) whose latest first/interim/final close is within 24 months and whose manager invested in public equity rounds in the last 12 months (at least 1 for fintech funds, 2 for generalist or unknown focus). Per fund: manager, latest close, size or target as announced (never converted), rounds_12m, rounds_since_close and the 3 latest rounds. Optional filters apply to the qualifying rounds: topic (topic slug, via the news linked to the round), country (company's country slug), stage (pre-seed, seed, series-a, series-b, series-c-plus, growth — derived from round_type). limit ≤ 50. Unknown arguments are rejected.

tools.name: coverage_check
tools.description: How many investors backed public fintech equity rounds in the last 12 months that match a country / stage / sub-sector, the top 3 investors by matching rounds (with whether they have a fund on Deploying now), and a coverage caveat (share of rounds in the period with a known country). Optional filters apply to the qualifying rounds: topic (topic slug, via the news linked to the round), country (company's country slug), stage (pre-seed, seed, series-a, series-b, series-c-plus, growth — derived from round_type). All arguments optional. Unknown arguments are rejected.

tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Fintech reports, white papers, surveys and data, newest first, with publisher, type, date and gated flag. Reports are published by the companies, investors, consultancies and analysts named as publisher; we link to the publisher's page and never host the file. Figures are quoted exactly as written, each with page_ref (a page number, or 'web' for an HTML page). gated = registration required at the publisher. Arguments: q (or query, ≥2 characters) matched against title and summary; topic (topic slug); publisher (organisation or person slug); report_type; year; gated (true/false); limit (≤50); cursor (next_cursor from a previous call). Use get_report for figures and coverage. Unknown arguments are rejected.

q.description: Text matched against report title and summary (at least 2 characters).

report_type.description: survey, market_data, index, white_paper, regulatory_analysis or industry_research.

gated.description: true = registration required at the publisher; false = free to read.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: One report by slug: publisher and co-publishers, date, type, gated flag, summary, up to 5 key figures (value and unit exactly as written, each with page_ref), methodology note, source_url (the publisher's own page for the report) and the news / newsletters that covered it. Reports are published by the companies, investors, consultancies and analysts named as publisher; we link to the publisher's page and never host the file. Figures are quoted exactly as written, each with page_ref (a page number, or 'web' for an HTML page). gated = registration required at the publisher. Unknown arguments are rejected.

tools.name: get_topic_digest
tools.description: The weekly digest for one topic (currently the topics with a digest, e.g. 'stablecoins', 'agentic-payments'): published news tagged with the topic or its sub-topics in one ISO week (Monday to Monday, Europe/Rome), newest first, plus the approved funding rounds linked to those stories. Amounts are never converted. Arguments: topic (required, topic slug), week (optional, 'YYYY-Www', e.g. '2026-W45'; omit for the current week). Always returns available_weeks (last 12 weeks with at least one story). Unknown topic → error listing the digest topics. Unknown arguments are rejected.

week.description: ISO week 'YYYY-Www' (e.g. '2026-W45'). Omit for the current week.

tools.name: search_organizations
tools.description: Search fintech companies and investors by name, kind or country. Returns public profiles with canonical URLs. Arguments: q (or query): text to search for, matched against the name. With no q the tool returns a plain alphabetical list (first 25 by default). Unknown arguments are rejected.

q.description: q (or query): text to search for. Omit for a plain alphabetical list.

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

country.description: Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Full public profile for one organization by slug: description, country, funding rounds (raised or led), people, any disclosure, editor_disclosure (current when the editor holds equity, past when it previously did, otherwise none), our published coverage of it (articles, newsletter issues, podcast episodes), and its products (company-provided, not part of the CC BY dataset), each with an agent_access object when API, sandbox, llms.txt, OpenAPI or MCP details are set. Also data_summary (sentences derived only from our own rows, with data_summary_at; null when there is too little data), lei, licences[] (approved register entries, each with source_url and last_checked_at) and certifications[] (self-reported by the company, with evidence_url).

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search founders, operators and investors covered by the publication. Arguments: q (or query): text to search for, matched against the full name. With no q the tool returns a plain alphabetical list (first 25 by default). Unknown arguments are rejected.

q.description: q (or query): text to search for. Omit for a plain alphabetical list.

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Full public profile for one person by slug: bio, roles and coverage.

tools.name: list_funding_rounds
tools.description: Approved funding rounds, newest first, with optional filters and keyset pagination. Pass the returned next_cursor fields (after_date, after_id) to get the next page.

country.description: Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive. Matches the company's country.

category.description: Round category: equity, debt, grant or ipo (initial public offering; amount is the offering size when disclosed). Fund closes are not rounds: use search_funds and list_fund_closes.

amount_min.description: Minimum disclosed amount in the announced currency.

after_date.description: Cursor: announced date of the last row seen.

after_id.description: Cursor: id of the last row seen.

tools.name: largest_rounds
tools.description: Largest disclosed equity rounds, ranked per currency (amounts are never converted between currencies).

tools.name: most_active_investors
tools.description: Investors ranked by the number of approved rounds they appear in. Category defaults to equity. With a country, only rounds of companies headquartered in that country are counted; the country may be a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'), case-insensitive.

country.description: Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive. Counts rounds of companies headquartered there.

category.description: Round category (equity, debt, grant, ipo). Defaults to equity. Fund closes: use list_fund_closes.

tools.name: funding_summary
tools.description: Counts for a slice of the funding database: rounds, countries, totals per announced currency, undisclosed rounds and rounds per category. Note: rounds, per_currency and undisclosed count equity rounds only, while by_category covers every round category (equity, debt, grant, ipo; fund closes are separate, see list_fund_closes), so the category split can sum higher than the round count.

country.description: Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_funding_index
tools.description: The weekly Builders Fintech Funding Index of approved equity rounds (ISO weeks). Arguments: week (optional, 'YYYY-Www', e.g. '2026-W39') returns that week; otherwise the latest weeks, newest first. weeks (optional, 1–104, default 1) sets how many. Count Index = rounds this week / average of the prior 12 weeks × 100. USD median index uses disclosed USD rounds only (needs 5). Amounts are never converted. Published values are frozen; revised_* shows later corrections. coverage_affected is true when a coverage change falls in the week or its 12-week baseline; coverage_note then explains how the index overstates activity. Unknown arguments are rejected.

week.description: ISO week, 'YYYY-Www' (e.g. '2026-W39'). Omit for the latest.

tools.name: get_signals_report
tools.description: The monthly Fintech Signals report: stored figures for approved equity rounds in one month (headline rounds and per-currency totals/medians, comparison with previous months, largest rounds per currency, stages, countries with 3+ rounds, topics with 5+ rounds, investors with 2+ rounds, and debt/fund/IPO items not counted). Amounts are never converted; totals and rankings are per currency. Arguments: month (optional, 'YYYY-MM'); omit for the latest published edition. Always returns available_months. Each report carries date_published and date_modified (revised_at, else the item's last content update, else published). Unknown arguments are rejected.

tools.name: get_investor_scorecard
tools.description: Follow-on scorecard for one investor by slug: of the portfolio companies it first backed at least the window ago, the share that raised a later approved round (equity or IPO) within the window, at least gap_days after entry. Only returned when the investor has at least min_eligible eligible companies. Arguments: slug (required). Unknown arguments are rejected.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search fintech products by text, category, market, API availability, agent access (has_mcp, has_sandbox, has_api) or customer type. Each product carries an agent_access object (api_available, docs_url, openapi_url, sandbox_url, llms_txt_url, auth_method, mcp_url) when any of these is set, and playground_status (open | no_runnable_tools | login_required | broken | unknown) with playground_checked_at. Company-provided, not part of the CC BY dataset. Each result carries provided_by, last_confirmed_at and sponsored; sponsorship never changes ordering. Arguments: q (or query) matched against name and short description; with no q the tool lists products alphabetically. cursor is the opaque next_cursor from a previous page. Unknown arguments are rejected.

q.description: q (or query): text to search for. Omit for a plain alphabetical list.

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

country.description: Market. Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive.

api_available.description: Only products with (true) or without (false) an API.

has_mcp.description: Only products with a public MCP server.

has_api.description: Only products with an API (API flag, API documentation or OpenAPI spec).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full public listing for one product by slug: description, category, markets, customer type, API, pricing model, links, the company and an agent_access object (api_available, docs_url, openapi_url, sandbox_url, llms_txt_url, auth_method, mcp_url) when any is set, plus the company's lei, licences[] (with source_url and last_checked_at) and certifications[] (self-reported), and playground_status with playground_checked_at. Company-provided, not part of the CC BY dataset. Each result carries provided_by, last_confirmed_at and sponsored; sponsorship never changes ordering.

tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: Find companies by product category, licence (licensed_in matches the home country or any passported country), licence type, authority, and agent access (has_sandbox, has_mcp, has_api), optionally min_agent_ready (1–5, the product's Agent-Ready score; available once those results are published). Returns each company with its approved products (with agent_access), LEI, licence summaries and self-reported certifications. Every licence carries source_url and last_checked_at so you can verify it on the regulator's register. From public registers as of the last-checked date. Always confirm on the regulator's register before relying on it. Use list_provider_filters for valid slugs. Ordered by company name, then slug. cursor is the next_cursor from a previous page. Unknown arguments are rejected.

licensed_in.description: Two-letter ISO country code; matches home or passported licences.

has_sandbox.description: Only companies with a product that has a sandbox.

has_mcp.description: Only companies with a product that has a public MCP server.

has_api.description: Only companies with a product that has an API (flag, docs or OpenAPI).

q.description: q (or query): text matched against company and product names.

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

min_agent_ready.description: Only companies with a product whose Agent-Ready score is at least this (1–5). Available once Agent-Ready results are published.

tools.name: list_provider_filters
tools.description: Valid values for find_providers: product category slugs, licence type slugs, authority slugs, and the ISO codes of countries that have at least one public licence (home or passported).

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Full-text search across published news, newsletter issues, podcast episodes, public entity pages, funding rounds and products. Result kinds: news, newsletter, podcast, company, investor, person, topic, country, funding_round, product; funding_round results also carry company, round_type (as recorded; null when not disclosed), round_label (a stage derived from the amount, only when round_type is empty; not the official round name), category, amount, currency, display_amount and announced_at; news, newsletter and podcast results carry editorial_format ('news', 'analysis' or 'signals'). Arguments: q (or query): text to search for, at least 2 characters — required, this tool has no plain-list mode. editorial_format (optional, 'news' | 'analysis' | 'signals'; 'signals' = the monthly funding report, see get_signals_report): return only publication items with that format. Unknown arguments are rejected.

q.description: q (or query): text to search for (required, min 2 characters).

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

editorial_format.description: Optional: only news/newsletter/podcast items with this format.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Our latest published news items, newest first. Each item has title, our own summary, published_at, source_name and source_url (we link to the original; no third-party article text is returned), permalink, url, linked companies, the linked funding round (amount as announced, never converted) or fund, and is_breaking. Arguments (all optional): since (ISO 8601 time; only items published after it), topic (topic slug, see list_topics), country (slug or ISO code), story_type ('funding' | 'fund-close'), limit (default 20, max 50). Unknown arguments are rejected.

since.description: ISO 8601 time; only items published after it, e.g. 2026-11-15T08:00:00Z.

country.description: Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive.

story_type.description: Only funding-round stories or fund-close stories.

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: One published item by type and slug, with its body text (truncated), topics, countries, organizations and people. News items also include a corrections array (date + note), newest first.

tools.name: search_podcast_knowledge
tools.description: Search attributed facts and question-and-answer pairs from Builders in Fintech podcast episodes (as stated by the guest, not independently verified). Arguments: q (or query) matched against fact text, and against questions and answers; organization (slug) = facts linked to that company or investor; person (slug) = facts said by that person; fact_type (figure, fact, plan, view); episode (podcast episode slug); limit; cursor (next_cursor from the previous page). With no q the tool lists the newest facts. The qa array is returned only when q is given and honours q and episode only. Unknown arguments are rejected.

q.description: q (or query): text to search for. Omit to list the newest facts.

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

organization.description: Organization slug: facts linked to it.

person.description: Person slug: facts said by them.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Approved fintech events, upcoming by default, with optional country, format, topic and month filters.

upcoming.description: Only events that have not ended yet (default true).

country.description: Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Every public topic with its slug and URL, for use as a filter in the other tools.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Countries that have public coverage, with company and content counts.

tools.name: get_daily_digest
tools.description: One edition of the Builders in Fintech daily digest (weekdays): the equity rounds that became public in its window (largest first within USD, EUR, GBP, then other currencies; never converted), news published in the window, one upcoming event and any podcast episode. Arguments: date (optional, 'YYYY-MM-DD'); omit for the latest published edition. Only published editions are returned. Unknown arguments are rejected.

date.description: Edition date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Omit for the latest.

tools.name: list_raising
tools.description: Fintech companies that pitched Builders in Fintech and opted in to a public listing while they raise: company name, website, one-liner, stage, country, target raise (never converted) and a featured flag (featured = the 3 most recently approved live listings). Listings are provided by the companies, not verified, and not an offer. Argument: featured_only (optional boolean: only the 3 featured listings). Unknown arguments are rejected.

featured_only.description: Only the 3 most recently approved live listings.

tools.name: about
tools.description: What this database covers, how to cite it, and where the bulk downloads live.
